source_review.notes: Reviewed all twelve references for identity, revision or edition, date, and scope. The official ISO record confirms ISO/IEC/IEEE 14764:2022 as the published third edition and explicitly includes the related lifecycle disposal process. NIST records confirm SP 800-88 Revision 2 as the September 2025 final publication superseding Revision 1, SP 800-37 Revision 2 as lifecycle risk-management guidance, and SP 800-53 Revision 5 including component-disposal control SR-12. RFC Editor records confirm RFC 8594 as the 2019 Informational Sunset field and RFC 9745 as the March 2025 Standards Track Deprecation field. Fowler's maintained Transitional Architecture page was checked on 2026-09-06. Publisher records confirmed the cited Nygard, Humble-Farley, Newman, and Bass-Clements-Kazman editions.

evidence: Reviewed retirement unit, obligation set, evidence and acceptance predicate, known and unresolved consumers, final position, authority epoch, in-flight work, data classes and disposition, observation duration, event count, tail probability, and upper event rate before use.
Checked finite conjunction, membership, universal obligation claim, natural logarithm, exponential probability, tail equation, rate units, and approximation notation.
Confirmed the gate set can itself be incomplete and that the probability model cannot establish structural absence.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The Poisson upper bound is explicitly conditional on stationary, complete, independent-enough observation assumptions.

evidence: Executed the retirement-gate example and independently confirmed failed recovery plus pending contracts yield ready=false and the sorted blocker list.
Recomputed the thirty-day 95% upper rate as -ln(0.05)/30 = 0.0998577..., rendered 0.0999 per day.
Recomputed Exercise 2 as -ln(0.01)/60 = 0.0767528... per day, approximately one event per thirteen days under the model.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Rates are model-based bounds and not observations of a real component.

evidence: Verified a single unaccepted obligation makes the conjunction false regardless of other passed gates.
Derived the zero-event upper rate by setting exp(-lambda*T)=alpha, taking logarithms, and dividing by negative T.
Verified longer complete observation lowers the conditional upper rate for fixed alpha while never proving no structural consumer.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No Bayesian prior, seasonality correction, or universal confidence interpretation is implied.

evidence: Reviewed annual and seasonal callers, disabled clients, missing telemetry, direct database users, queues, timers, in-flight effects, failed acknowledgments, stale restores, cached DNS, reused names, and inherited controls.
Reviewed retained archives, legal holds, replicas, backups, plaintext copies, cryptographic erase assumptions, provider media, revoked keys, supplier termination, and lost operational knowledge.
Reviewed payment, university, disability, academic, judicial, privacy, accessibility, records, research, labor, security, and regulatory authority limits.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Irreversible disposal is sequenced after reversible denial, quiescence, reconciliation, and recovery evidence.

evidence: Traced preserved or explicitly retired outcomes, one authority, terminal in-flight work, authenticated consumer migration, interpretable retained records, approved disposal, removed trust, non-resurrecting recovery, closed obligations, and post-removal observation.
Confirmed every data class is assigned across primary, replica, cache, log, backup, export, and support-copy surfaces rather than only the main store.
Confirmed tombstone and monitoring paths remain nonauthoritative and have owners and expiry.
invariant_checking.notes: A powered-off process or zero traffic is never treated as sufficient retirement evidence.

evidence: Reviewed the conjunction proof for its explicit universal retirement claim and finite declared gate set.
Reviewed the zero-event derivation for sign, logarithm domain, positive duration, and tail-probability assumptions.
Reviewed authority, drain, and disposition arguments to ensure routing, queue metrics, and primary-store deletion are not promoted to end-to-end guarantees.
proof_review.notes: The arguments establish insufficiency or conditional bounds, not authorization to decommission an external system.

evidence: Audited uses of proof, confidence, upper bound, complete, accepted, authority, sanitize, destroy, safe, archive, recovery, guarantee, current, and retired for assumptions and scope.
Confirmed Sunset is characterized as a hint, deletion is distinguished from sanitization, archive from authority, and backup from verified recovery.
Confirmed technical evidence does not decide records, privacy, accessibility, academic, legal, labor, or regulatory policy.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No internal dossier or standard is mislabeled as external certification.

evidence: Executed snippet evaluate-retirement-gates with the repository verifier under Python 3.14.4.
Observed exit status 0, exact readiness and blocker lines, zero_call_upper_per_day=0.0999, and empty standard error.
Confirmed billing, tax, order, recovery, invoice, storage, authentication, supplier, hostname, payment, and university cases are hypothetical.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The execution validates one finite dictionary evaluation and arithmetic calculation only.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed retirement scope, accountability, consumer discovery, authority, behavior disposition, deprecation, evidence ledger, negative evidence, progressive disablement, drain, data and media disposition, identity, routing, recovery, inherited controls, operations, suppliers, knowledge, irreversible sequencing, dossier, observation, and benefit realization as one coherent graduate-level treatment.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed failure paths across traffic, databases, messages, files, timers, direct credentials, effects, DNS, certificates, identities, archives, replicas, backups, images, keys, provider media, controls, monitoring, pipelines, contracts, licenses, support, recovery, and unexpected post-removal access. The chapter provides actionable gates and ordering. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified graduate and professional decommissioning depth, a conjunctive readiness model, derived negative-evidence bound, executable gate check, five named invariants, eighteen distinct misconceptions, ten varied worked examples with conclusions, and five progressive exercises with complete answers ending in an unfamiliar university-records transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed. Source checks, structural validation, a conditional stochastic model, finite arithmetic, hypothetical cases, and one local Python execution do not discover every consumer, validate an external retirement, prove Poisson assumptions, authorize data disposition, establish sanitization of real media, guarantee recovery or sole authority, or provide academic, accessibility, privacy, security, records, legal, labor, financial, procurement, supplier, environmental, compliance, or regulatory approval.
